title: Theater review: ‘Sayaw ng mga Ilaw’ finds grace in dance amid tragedy
summary: Tanghalang Pilipino’s “Sayaw ng mga Ilaw” uses dance, music and the enduring imagery of light to tell a moving story of loss, courage and the human capacity to move beyond tragedy.
